title: Founder stakes vs. control
headline: Stake vs. control
subtitle: What three founder-CEOs own — and how many votes they cast.
Nvidia, Tesla, SpaceX and Meta, from public filings and disclosures.
caption:
Jensen Huang: 3.6% of Nvidia, and 3.6% of the vote.
Elon Musk: 19.8% of Tesla; 46.1% of SpaceX equity, 83.7% of its votes.
Mark Zuckerberg: 13.4% of Meta, 60.6% of the vote.
Class B shares carry 10 votes each. One page ↓
notes: Source card: 'Three founder CEOs: stake comparison', compiled Nov 13, 2026 (user-provided image). Numbers retained verbatim from that card and cross-checked: NVDA 3.6% economic + voting (Eastmoney research note, Nov 13 2026; no dual-class structure); TSLA 19.8% (Tesla Schedule 13G filed Jun 17 2026 shows 19.9% beneficial ownership, one share one vote, so equity = votes); SPCX 83.7% voting power (same research note; SpaceX 10-Q / prospectus report ~42-48% economic and ~82-88% votes, 46.1% is the pro-forma IPO economic figure); META 13.4% economic / 60.6% voting (Meta preliminary information statement Oct 21 2026; Fortune Oct 21 2026; Class B = 10 votes). OPM rules applied: English only, no diagonal watermark, teal/orange/gold palette, no three-chip row, enlarged type, generous whitespace. v2 (Nov 14): horizontal comparison bars replaced by donut/pie rings, one ring per figure, value inside the ring.
